rows.title: Production: AC Capacity Calculator （冷氣噸數計算機）
rows.body:
Build-first production candidate for the AC Capacity Calculator, built against the fixed spec candidate `a83a0b9ca975c43a3d7426e138720c2485901b8c` (`spec-ac-capacity-calculator-20261109`, spec task `labs-ac-capacity-calculator-spec-20261109`, draft spec PR #154). Scope: only `tools/ac-capacity-calculator/`. Base: `codex/initial-publication` @ `15f20a7afa234e8a9dc1d607a88379f89cd5656c`.

## What was built

- Exact BigInt rational pipeline (no floating point): size in ping directly or from m² via the fixed divisor 1 ping = 3.3058 m² (converted fraction never pre-rounded); base load 500 kcal/h per ping; adjustments ADD onto the base, never compound (west sun +10%, top floor +15%, large windows +10%, kitchen / heat source +10%, +3% per occupant above 2; occupants ≤ 2 never subtract).
- Every output rounds half-up once, from the exact required kcal/h: kcal/h, BTU/h (×3.968), kW (÷860 — the SPEC-pinned divisor), and tonnage as a labelled secondary figure only, under the named Taiwan retail rule of thumb 1 ton ≈ 2,500 kcal/h (refrigeration ton explicitly not used), with the SPEC's fixed tonnage note shown on every result.
- Model-size recommendation from the fixed table [2.2, 2.8, 3.6, 4.5, 5.0, 6.3, 7.1, 8.0, 9.0, 10.0] kW, compared on the EXACT unrounded kW (the `exact-vs-rounded-model` fixture: display 2.80 kW still recommends 3.6), plus the next size up; exact kW > 10.0 → both null, `modelOverRange: true`, fixed over-range note. Exact kW of exactly 10.0 recommends 10.0 with next null.

rows.title: Production: Discount Calculator （折扣計算機）
rows.body:
Build-first production candidate for `tools/discount-calculator/`, implementing the fixed spec `spec-discount-calculator-20261109` (candidate `0f2c7e279dce435552069dc8d92376ac36bb023d`, spec task `labs-discount-calculator-spec-20261109`, draft spec PR #135).

- Pure BigInt core: integer cents + basis points, per-step half-up; two stacked discounts multiply, coupon clamps at the discounted price, tax after discounts; savings/effective %/zhe measured pre-tax.
- Worker-backed controller (empty/dirty/busy/success/error/cancelled), bilingual static pages with the SPEC-pinned strings, canonical JSON breakdown download.
- `npm test` 38/38 pass (7 core + 3 controller literal fixtures deep-compared, plus hand-derived boundary/property cases); `npm run check` passed; `build:preview` byte-identical across two runs; `check:generated:preview` passed; loopback HTTP probe verified both pages, security headers, 404 and traversal handling.
- Real-browser and real-device evidence is NOT_RUN and listed explicitly in `tools/discount-calculator/VERIFICATION.md`. No spec-errata candidates. One documented layout deviation (handbook `public/js/...` paths instead of the SPEC template's `src/...` paths) is recorded in HANDOFF.md.
- Not registered/submitted in the coordination registry by the builder; that step stays with the coordinator. Not accepted, not merged, not deployed.
